description: This file defines the DatabaseFileUsageBackend class, which implements a backend for tracking file usage in Drupal using a database. It includes methods for adding, deleting, and listing file usage records.

classes.name: DatabaseFileUsageBackend
classes.description: A class that manages file usage data in the database for Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the backend with configuration, database connection, and table name.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a record of file usage to the database, updating the count if necessary.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes or decrements file usage records from the database.

methods.name: listUsage
methods.description: Retrieves a list of usage references for a specific file.
